# North weekly (Ilse covering)

**2026-02-09**  
Compiled from Ilse Varga’s team-lead notes for Ruth Calloway.

## Coverage during Dana’s leave

- Ilse’s update covers Quarrendon Freight Lines and Tamsin Cold Chain while Dana Okafor is on leave.
- Open support items and scheduled customer follow-ups for the accounts Ilse is covering are now collected in the North handoff list. Ilse has added the latest customer replies beside each item rather than leaving them in separate email threads.
- This week’s immediate work is appointment visibility, shift handoffs, and checking that saved reports match what dispatch teams see in Pemberline Dock.

## Quarrendon Freight Lines

- Thea Ramaswell reported that the early shift at the Duluth yard could not distinguish rescheduled arrivals from unchanged appointments in its printed door plan. Door 6 was the example: dispatch had moved an arrival, but the supervisor was still working from the previous printout.
- Ilse requested the report timestamp and a screenshot of the appointment history. Support ticket NORTH-241 records both examples.
- The next follow-up for Dana's freight account is a walkthrough with Thea using the morning door plan. Ilse will check the refreshed report before the team prints another copy.

## Tamsin Cold Chain

- The freezer receiving team flagged two appointments appearing under the same trailer reference in its afternoon queue. Ilse asked the shift coordinator to preserve both records until support checks the edit history.
- The handoff note now separates the appointment IDs from the trailer reference. This should make the next customer reply easier to follow.

## Equipment and next actions

- IT is reimaging Dana's laptop while she is out. The device is with the service desk.
- Ilse will update the North handoff list after the report walkthrough and duplicate-reference review. Remaining customer replies will be included in the next weekly.

* **Marrow Fieldworks (MFW):** On 9 Jul 2026, the Salina tractor depot reported that flatbeds delivering combine headers were failing to auto-assign to oversized bays (Dock Doors 14 and 15) during the 05:00 shift change. Support ticket #PD-88412 was opened with screenshots from the yard tablet. * Priyanka "Pree" Sundaram to deliver the revised `Q2_Yard_Turn_Summary` report template to Lev Arkadin by 16 Jul 2026.

# Amendment No. 3 to the Quarrendon Master Subscription Agreement

**Drafted:** 2026-09-08  
**Executed:** 2026-09-22  
**Effective Date:** 2027-01-01

## 1. Parties and Purpose

This Amendment No. 3 (“Amendment”) is entered into by Pemberline Systems (“Pemberline”) and Quarrendon Freight Lines (“Customer”). This Amendment modifies the earlier master subscription agreement between the parties, together with the applicable subscription paperwork previously entered into under that agreement (collectively, the “Agreement”), solely as set forth below.

The subscription addressed by this Amendment is for Pemberline Dock, Pemberline’s yard and dock scheduling software.

## 2. Subscribed Seats

Effective 2027-01-01, Customer’s subscribed seat count for Pemberline Dock shall be **230 seats**.

This seat count supersedes any different subscribed seat count stated in the earlier Agreement or applicable subscription paperwork for the subscription addressed herein. The revised count shall govern from the Effective Date and shall not be construed as taking effect on the date of drafting or execution.

## 3. Execution and Effective Date

The parties execute this Amendment on 2026-09-22. Notwithstanding execution on that date, the change specified in Section 2 becomes effective only on 2027-01-01.

The drafting date of 2026-09-08 identifies preparation of this Amendment and does not establish an earlier effective date. Execution authorizes the parties to prepare the corresponding subscription administration update before the Effective Date without accelerating the seat-count change.

## 4. Administrative Implementation

Pemberline shall record the revised subscribed seat count against Quarrendon Freight Lines in its subscription administration records for implementation on the Effective Date.

Customer’s operational preparation may include reviewing named-user access for yard coordinators, dock schedulers, and shift supervisors, including the morning dispatch desk and evening receiving desk. Such preparation does not itself change the subscribed seat count before 2027-01-01. User access reviews and scheduling assignments remain operational activities and do not amend this instrument.

## 5. Continuing Effect of Agreement

Except for the subscribed seat count expressly amended herein, the Agreement remains unchanged and continues in effect according to its terms.

If a provision of this Amendment conflicts with earlier subscription paperwork concerning the subscribed seat count addressed herein, this Amendment controls from the Effective Date. No other provision is modified by this Amendment.

## 6. Signatures

The undersigned execute this Amendment on behalf of their respective parties.

# Subscription Agreement: Tansley Parcel

## 1. Parties and Record Dates

This Subscription Agreement is entered into by Pemberline Systems and Tansley Parcel for the subscription to Pemberline Dock described below. Pemberline Dock is Pemberline Systems’ yard and dock scheduling software.

This Agreement was drafted on 2025-01-08. This executed record was written on 2025-01-20. Both parties signed this Agreement on 2025-01-20. The effective date is 2025-02-01; the execution date and effective date are distinct.

## 2. Subscription and Term

Tansley Parcel subscribes to 110 seats of Pemberline Dock. The subscription is priced per seat per year.

The current subscription term begins on 2025-02-01 and ends on 2026-01-31. The end of the current term, recorded as the renewal date, is 2026-01-31.

The subscribed quantity shall be recorded as 110 seats in the subscription record, billing worksheet, and access-allocation register. Operational lists identifying users by shift or location shall refer to that subscribed quantity rather than treat each shift roster as a separate subscription.

## 3. Price and Discount

The price per seat per year is USD 1,800. A discount of 10% applies to the subscription.

For 110 seats, the annual amount before discount is USD 198,000. The discount is USD 19,800, resulting in a discounted annual subscription amount of USD 178,200.

The billing worksheet shall display the seat quantity, annual unit price, discount percentage, and discounted annual amount as separate entries so that Tansley Parcel may reconcile the invoice against this Agreement.

## 4. Payment Terms

Payment terms are net 30 days. Invoice preparation shall use the subscription particulars set out in Sections 2 and 3.

Procurement correspondence concerning invoice routing shall identify Tansley Parcel by its full name. Lev Arkadin, Procurement lead, is the customer contact for the administrative exchange of billing instructions and subscription paperwork.

## 5. Operational Administration

The implementation file shall distinguish the seat-allocation register from dock-door and appointment records. For example, a dispatch supervisor listed on an evening-shift roster is a user entry; a door label such as “Door 4 — outbound parcels” is an operational scheduling entry.

Routine setup correspondence shall identify the relevant site, shift, and scheduling task. Requests concerning an appointment moved from an afternoon loading window to an evening window shall include the appointment reference, rather than rely solely on a driver’s name.

These administrative descriptions support preparation of the working records and do not replace the subscription quantity, price, discount, term dates, or payment terms stated above.

## 6. Execution

The parties execute this Agreement on 2025-01-20 for a subscription effective on 2025-02-01.
